column1: # KB-12 — the nonrd estimate arm's "leaf-mode near-tie" was aom_hadamard_lp_8x8's
# base commit  2a5ddac (fix(encode): KB-28 — the framesize predicates read the TRUE CROP)
# host         Apple M4 Pro, Darwin 25.5.0 arm64
# build        cargo test --profile test-fast -j 4, default dispatch (aarch64 NEON live)
# content      synthetic canon grids (speed8/9 gates) + mirror-tiled first KEY frame of
#              ALLINTRA usage=2, single KEY frame, 1 tile, stock knobs
# reference    real libaom aom_codec_av1_cx via aom-sys-ref; compared unit is the frame-OBU payload
#   post     = the landed fix (hadamard_lp_8x8 ends with C's coeff[i*8+j] = buffer2[j*8+i])
#   pre      = bite proof: that loop reverted to `coeff[..64].copy_from_slice(&buffer2)`,
#              nothing else changed. Reproduces every previously-recorded number exactly.
# The blast radius is ONE caller: block_yrd_lowbd, i.e. av1_block_yrd's use_hbd==0 branch,
# reached only from av1_nonrd_pick_intra_mode at --cpu-used 8/9 and bd8. Speeds 0..7, every
# bd10/bd12 cell, and every decoder gate are byte-unchanged by the fix.
# WHY IT WAS INVISIBLE: of everything the estimate arm derives from these coefficients, only
# the EOB is order-sensitive. aom_satd_lp and av1_block_error_lp sum the whole array; eob==0
# (skippable) is a set property; eob==1 can only mean the DC, the transpose's fixed point.
# Measured over 4,000 correlated 8x8 blocks at qindex 128 (the teeth test):
# The eob reaches the rate only through eob_cost += get_msb(eob+1), rate += eob_cost << 9.
# KB-32's decode-both localizer, both arms. Under `pre` it lands on exactly the leaf and mode
# pair KB-32 recorded on 2026-08-01; under `post` every cell is byte-identical so it reports
# nothing. Partition trees agree in BOTH arms — this root never touched the tree.
